schema.name: positions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE positions(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            cohort_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            signal_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            opened_epoch REAL NOT NULL,
            opened_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            target_epoch REAL NOT NULL,
            target_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            closed_epoch REAL,
            closed_at TEXT,
            instrument TEXT NOT NULL,
            direction TEXT NOT NULL,
            side TEXT NOT NULL,
            horizon_sec INTEGER NOT NULL,
            horizon_label TEXT NOT NULL,
            family TEXT,
            lane_id TEXT,
            input_timeframe TEXT,
            policy_state TEXT NOT NULL,
            signal_eligible INTEGER NOT NULL,
            validated INTEGER NOT NULL,
            direction_conflict INTEGER NOT NULL,
            blocked_by_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            confidence REAL NOT NULL,
            projected_net_pips REAL NOT NULL,
            projected_net_pips_per_hour REAL NOT NULL,
            gross_to_spread REAL NOT NULL,
            entry_bid REAL NOT NULL,
            entry_ask REAL NOT NULL,
            entry_mid REAL NOT NULL,
            entry_spread_pips REAL NOT NULL,
            exit_bid REAL,
            exit_ask REAL,
            exit_mid REAL,
            gross_pips REAL,
            net_pips REAL,
            win INTEGER,
            best_net_pips REAL,
            worst_net_pips REAL,
            time_to_positive_sec REAL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL
        , measurement_version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy_filtered_direction_v1', direction_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy_filtered_direction', outcome_quote_epoch REAL, outcome_quote_at TEXT, target_quote_distance_sec REAL, maturity_valid INTEGER, maturity_reason TEXT, source_signal_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', signal_lineage_contract_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy_source_signal_id', direction_conflict_contract_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy_direction_conflict', direction_conflict_details_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}')

schema.name: position_status_horizon
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX position_status_horizon
        ON positions(status, horizon_sec)

schema.name: position_closed_epoch
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX position_closed_epoch
        ON positions(closed_epoch DESC)

schema.name: position_status_measurement_maturity
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX position_status_measurement_maturity
        ON positions(status, measurement_version, maturity_valid)

schema.name: position_status_maturity
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX position_status_maturity
        ON positions(status, maturity_valid)

schema.name: position_factor_episode_order
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX position_factor_episode_order
        ON positions(
            status, measurement_version, maturity_valid,
            policy_state, opened_epoch
        )

schema.name: position_recent_status_epoch
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX position_recent_status_epoch
        ON positions(
            (CASE status WHEN 'open' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),
            COALESCE(closed_epoch, target_epoch) DESC
        )

schema.name: position_policy_repair
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX position_policy_repair
        ON positions(policy_state, direction_conflict, measurement_version)

schema.name: ledger_revision
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE ledger_revision(
            singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
            position_revision INTEGER NOT NULL
        , metadata_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, mature_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

query_plan: SEARCH positions USING INDEX position_factor_episode_order (status=? AND measurement_version=? AND maturity_valid=?)
